ir8_shadow.topic: Israel's (and US) covert campaign against Iran's nuclear programme, 2007-2023

claims.text: Killings and attacks on Iranian nuclear scientists: Masoud Alimohammadi killed January 2010 by an apparently remote-controlled bomb on a motorcycle; Majid Shahriari killed late November 2010 by a bomb attached to his car by a motorcyclist, wife and driver wounded; Fereydoon Abbasi wounded the same day in a similar attack; Darioush Rezaeinejad shot by two gunmen on motorcycles July 2011 (Iran rejected Israeli reports linking him to a nuclear lab); Mostafa Ahmadi Roshan killed January 2012 by a magnetic bomb with his driver. US and Israel denied involvement in Shahriari killing; Ahmadinejad blamed 'the hand of the Zionist regime'; US condemned and denied the Roshan killing; IDF spokesman Yoav Mordechai: 'But I am definitely not shedding a tear.'

NYT (18 Sep 2021, via New Arab): Fakhrizadeh killed 27 Nov 2020 near Absard driving with his wife; a modified Belgian FN MAG machine gun on a robotic apparatus with AI, smuggled into Iran in parts and reassembled, about a ton, fired by an operator thousands of miles away; 15 bullets in under 60 seconds; a truck with explosives detonated afterward; Israel tracked him since at least 2007; preparation began late 2019/early 2020; NYT: assassination 'would derail any chance of resurrecting the nuclear agreement even if Mr. Biden won'; Iran blamed Israel and vowed revenge; IRGC claimed a satellite-controlled AI weapon.

AP 11 Apr 2021: power cut across Natanz; spokesman Kamalvandi said no casualty or damage; Iran called it 'nuclear terrorism'; Israeli media reported a cyberattack, Kan said Israel likely responsible (unsourced); Israel did not claim it; Natanz's advanced centrifuge assembly plant suffered a mysterious explosion in July 2020 that authorities later called sabotage; Kochavi said Israeli operations 'are not hidden from the eyes of the enemy'; the previous day Iran launched 164 IR-6 centrifuges.

NYT (15 Jul 2018, via Al Arabiya), citing Israeli officials: Mossad agents entered a Tehran warehouse at 10:30 p.m. on 31 January 2018 and left by 5 a.m., opening most of 32 Iranian-built safes and taking about 50,000 pages and 163 CDs; Iran called the haul fabricated; US and British officials validated it.

WaPo 19 Jun 2012: US (NSA, CIA) and Israel jointly developed Flame, which mapped and monitored Iran's networks to prepare cyber-sabotage; Israel unilaterally directed a disruption of Iran's oil industry computers, apparently catching US partners off guard; officials anonymous; Hayden declined to discuss.

29 Jan 2023: three drones attacked a defence ministry 'workshop' near Isfahan; Iran said two were shot down, one caused 'minor damage', no injuries; Amir-Abdollahian called it 'cowardly'; WSJ citing US officials said Israel was behind it; US officials said the US had no role; no Israeli comment.

ir8_iranside.topic: Iran's side of the shadow war: plots abroad, shipping, cyber, detentions

claims.text: 13 Feb 2012: a magnetic bomb attached by a motorcyclist wrecked an Israeli embassy car in New Delhi, wounding the diplomat (surgery, not life-threatening), her driver and two passers-by; in Tbilisi a bomb on an embassy car was defused; Netanyahu called Iran 'the biggest exporter of terror in the world'; Iran's FM spokesman Mehmanparast: 'It seems that these suspicious incidents are designed by the Zionist regime.'

March 2012: Indian police named three Iranians as main suspects in the Delhi attack, who entered on tourist visas and left; warrants issued; an Indian freelance journalist who worked part-time for IRNA was arrested.

Bangkok, 14 Feb 2012: explosives (five C-4 devices hidden in radios) blew up in a rented house; Saeid Moradi threw a bomb at police and lost his legs; on 22 Aug 2013 a Thai court sentenced Moradi to life and Mohammad Khazaei to 15 years; both denied the charges; Israel's ambassador said the sentence proved Iran engaged in terror.

WSJ (11 Mar 2021): since late 2019 Israel attacked at least 12 vessels bound for Syria, mostly carrying Iranian oil, with water and limpet mines; some reportedly carried weapons; no sinkings or casualties reported; Israeli and Iranian officials did not comment. Helios Ray (Israeli-owned) hit 25 Feb 2021 in the Gulf of Oman; Israel blamed the IRGC; Iran denied and called it a false flag; IRISL called the 10 Mar 2021 Shahr-e Kord incident a 'terrorist' attack.

Mercer Street, managed by Zodiac Maritime (Eyal Ofer's Zodiac Group), hit by drones off Oman on 29 Jul 2021; two crew killed (British, Romanian); Blinken 'confident' Iran did it; Raab: 'highly likely'; Bennett: 'Iran is the one who carried out the attack'; Iran's Khatibzadeh: accusation 'baseless'; no physical evidence released publicly; first known fatal attack in the shipping campaign begun summer 2019.

WaPo (via Al Jazeera, 19 May 2020): hackers disrupted Shahid Rajaee port on 9 May 2020; officials said Israeli operatives did it in retaliation for an Iranian attempt on 24 April 2020 to penetrate computers running Israeli rural water systems, which failed and caused no damage; Iran denied the water attack; Iran's port chief said hackers 'failed to penetrate' PMO systems; Israel did not comment.

18 Sep 2023: five Americans the US said were 'unjustly detained' (incl. Siamak Namazi, Emad Shargi, Morad Tahbaz) freed in exchange for five Iranians and transfer of $6bn of frozen Iranian funds to Qatar for humanitarian purchases; US officials warned Iran may keep using detained Americans as bargaining chips; new Levinson Act sanctions on Iran's intelligence ministry.

ir8_open.topic: 2024: the shadow war in the open (Damascus, True Promise I and II, Isfahan, Haniyeh, Days of Repentance)

claims.text: 1 Apr 2024 strike demolished Iran's consulate building in Damascus; killed Gen. Mohammad Reza Zahedi (Quds Force head in Lebanon and Syria until 2016), his deputy Gen. Mohammad Hadi Hajriahimi, five other Iranian officers and a Hezbollah member; Khamenei said Iran would make the attackers 'regretful'; Israel did not confirm and had no comment; US NSC said it played no role and did not know beforehand.

13-14 Apr 2024 (True Promise): IDF spokesman Hagari: more than 120 ballistic missiles, 170 drones and more than 30 cruise missiles; Israeli officials: 99% intercepted; IDF credited US, UK and France, Jordan shot some down; a seven-year-old girl severely injured by fragments; IDF: minor damage to a southern base; IRGC framed it as response to the consulate strike; Iran's UN mission cited Article 51 and said 'The matter can be deemed concluded'.

19 Apr 2024: a US official told ABC Israeli jets fired three missiles at a radar site tied to air defences for Natanz in Isfahan province; satellite imagery showed damage to an S-300 radar at the Eighth Shekari air base; IAEA: no damage to nuclear sites; Amir-Abdollahian said downed mini-drones caused no damage; Ben-Gvir posted 'Weak'; Blinken: US 'not involved in any offensive operations'; Biden reportedly told Netanyahu to 'Take the win'.

Haniyeh and a bodyguard killed about 2 a.m. on 31 Jul 2024 in Neshat, an IRGC guesthouse compound in north Tehran, while in Tehran for Pezeshkian's swearing-in; NYT (via ToI): a remote-detonated bomb hidden about two months earlier, per five Middle Eastern officials; IRGC officials called it a 'tremendous embarrassment'; IRGC statement 3 Aug: a 'short-range projectile' with about 7 kg of explosives fired from outside, supported by the US; US said it 'was not aware of or involved in' it; Israel neither confirmed nor denied at the time.

Israel Katz, 23 Dec 2024, at an event for defence ministry personnel: 'we will behead their leaders – just as we did to Haniyeh, Sinwar and Nasrallah in Tehran, Gaza and Lebanon' — Israel's first acknowledgement.

1 Oct 2024 (True Promise 2): at least 180 ballistic missiles in two waves; Iran cited the killings of Haniyeh (31 Jul), Nasrallah (27 Sep) and IRGC Brig. Gen. Abbas Nilforoushan; targets included Nevatim and Tel Nof; one Palestinian killed in Jericho, two Israelis lightly hurt; IRGC claimed 90% hits; Iran's UN mission: 'legal, rational, and legitimate response'; Netanyahu: Iran 'made a big mistake – and it will pay for it'; Biden: 'appears to have been defeated and ineffective'.

26 Oct 2024 (Days of Repentance): three waves; first on radar and air defences, later on missile and drone production sites, Parchin reportedly hit; IDF said 20 sites; Hagari: 'precise and targeted strikes'; Iran reported 'limited damage'; Israel told Biden administration beforehand; NSC's Savett called it 'an exercise in self-defence'; Israel: Iran would 'pay a heavy price' if it responded.
Iran's army first reported two, then four air-defence soldiers killed on 26 Oct 2024 (Shahrokhi, Jahandideh, Mansouri, Naqavi).
